evaluation: Frozen whole-segment 70/30 holdout: 5,187 training and 2,223 test windows; training-only three-fold stratified group CV
neural_inner_validation: Not used: fixed 25 epochs in each CV fold and final fit
neural_final_refit: Reinitialize and fit only the 70% training set for fixed 25 epochs
class_weights: inverse square root of training-only class counts, normalized to mean 1
primary_metric: macro F1 over the 12 prespecified activity labels (zero_division=0)
secondary_metrics: training CV mean and sample SD
notes: Protocol revision for course requirement. Split frozen before new model fits. Historical LOSO previously used all these recordings; this is not a new external test. Model selection uses training CV only. No tuning after new test results. Offline annotated-activity windows.
group_unit: Uninterrupted activity segment; subject identities can occur on both sides
